eval.description: Anthropic internal suite for task-gaming in coding: hard-coding or special-casing tests instead of solving the task. Categories include reward-hack-prone coding tasks (classifier and hidden-test rates), Claude Code impossible tasks (with and without anti-hack prompts), and training-distribution environments. Cards report classifier or automated-grader hack rates (lower is better).
eval.summary: Measures how often the model games coding tasks by special-casing tests instead of solving the real problem.

versions.changes: Problem sets and scaffolding are updated across cards (for example reward-hack-prone coding tasks v2).

scores.description: The attempt games the task (hard-coding, special-casing, or similar) under Anthropic’s classifiers or graders.

metrics.description: Share of attempts graded as reward hacking in a category (classifier or hidden-test).
